name: @role-orchestrator/memory-search
description: M3-03 retrieval, staleness and cross-project isolation over shared memory. openMemoryAccess binds ONE authorized projectId and every read/search/write entry point enforces it at the query layer (WHERE project_id = authorized, never result filtering); a foreign memory id is refused with a typed CrossProjectAccessError that discloses neither the foreign project nor its content (A15). Text search runs AND-tokenized SQL LIKE over the authoritative memories table of live statuses (verified/active by default). Memories carry sourceSha with a reference-check port plus a git adapter: a source SHA that is missing or superseded by the current baseline marks the memory stale (persisted stale_since/stale_reason + append-only memory_source_checks audit), retrieval hits carry the explicit stale mark, and context-bundle injection EXCLUDES stale memories by default (explicit opt-in injects them with a loud in-content marker — old evidence is never reused silently). Migration chain composes as MEMORY_SEARCH_MIGRATIONS = MEMORY_MIGRATIONS + 009 (source/staleness columns + checks table) + 010 (forward-only bundle_fragments rebuild admitting the context package's memory layer). A16 holds: memory content is data; nothing here turns content into permissions, bindings, profile selection or capability decisions.
